verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that representation exists: users can adhere to electronic notifications 'em representação', and there is a services area for Contabilistas Certificados. Nothing in the pack shows a published statement of what a third party may or may not do, any authorization forms, defined role scopes, or which signatures must stay personal. Representation existing as a feature is adjacent to this story, not the published delegation scope it asks for.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
